name: Shera
source:
A girl from the world where witches live.
Under an agreement made between her mother and the Hero's father, she visited the Hero named Satoru .
She fell in love with him at first sight and ever since has tried to show her love aggressively.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/r18/Titles/Details/6EA5B6D1-BC3B-4287-AF65-8F1EB16A347C/shera-my-witch]MangaGamer[/url]]
